name: spotrc-workspace
description: Control the Spotify desktop app from your terminal

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.build:bin: bun build --compile packages/cli/src/main.ts --outfile dist/spotrc && bun build --compile packages/jsonrpc/src/main.ts --outfile dist/spotrc-jsonrpc && bun build --compile packages/mcp/src/main.ts --outfile dist/spotrc-mcp
